result.evidence: The lesson plays smoothly and interactions work, but there is a pervasive rendering issue. Unrendered LaTeX code (specifically the \ce{} macro for chemical formulas) appears as raw text in multiple sections, such as below the animation at 1:27, in the Key Players table at 2:07, and throughout the Near Transfer section starting at 10:08.

issues.description: Unrendered LaTeX code (\ce{OH}) is visible in the text below the animation.
Unrendered LaTeX code (\ce{-CH3}, \ce{OH}) appears in the Key Players table.
Unrendered LaTeX code (\ce{-H}, \ce{Cl}, etc.) is shown throughout the Near Transfer section.

result.score_reason: The lesson contains several major rendering problems where raw LaTeX code is displayed instead of formatted chemical formulas, meeting the criteria for Level 3.
